dialogues.jp:
たらたら歩きながら帰ってくると、見慣れた制
服姿が目に入った。
dialogues.en: While walking home, I saw a familiar school uniform.
dialogues.text: While walking home, I saw a familiar school uniform.

dialogues.jp: 「よ、工藤」
dialogues.en: "Yo, Kudou."
dialogues.text: "Yo, Kudou."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「ああ……朝倉か」
dialogues.en: "Ahh... Asakura."
dialogues.text: "Ahh... Asakura."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「お前、家この辺だったっけ？」
dialogues.en: "Your house isn't in this neighbourhood, is it?"
dialogues.text: "Your house isn't in this neighbourhood, is it?"

dialogues.jp:
工藤、なんて表札は見たことないような気がす
るけどな。
dialogues.en:
I don't remember ever seeing the name Kudou on any of the
nameplates around here.
dialogues.text:
I don't remember ever seeing the name Kudou on any of the
nameplates around here.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「いや……ちょっとお祖母さまのお遣いで」
dialogues.en: "No... I'm just carrying out an errand for grandmother."
dialogues.text: "No... I'm just carrying out an errand for grandmother."

dialogues.jp: そう言って古風な風呂敷包みを見せる。
dialogues.en: His words led me to the old-style cloth bag he was carrying.
dialogues.text: His words led me to the old-style cloth bag he was carrying.

dialogues.jp:
なるほど。だがそれより俺は、工藤の言葉づか
いに引っかかりを覚えた。
dialogues.en: I see. But something he said bothered me somehow...
dialogues.text: I see. But something he said bothered me somehow...

dialogues.jp: 「なんだよ、『お祖母さま』って」
dialogues.en: "Grandmother? Why do you call her so formally?"
dialogues.text: "Grandmother? Why do you call her so formally?"

dialogues.jp: 驚いたように口を押さえて赤くなる工藤。
dialogues.en: His mouth agape in slight shock, he started glowing red.
dialogues.text: His mouth agape in slight shock, he started glowing red.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「き、気にしないでくれよ。家でそう呼び慣れ
　てるもんだから……」
dialogues.en:
"D, don't worry about it, I'm used to calling her that way
at her house..."
dialogues.text:
"D, don't worry about it, I'm used to calling her that way
at her house..."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「ふーん……ひょっとして、お前んちって、由
　緒正しき名家だったりとか？」
dialogues.en: "Huh... is your family line some famous one or something?"
dialogues.text: "Huh... is your family line some famous one or something?"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「いや……その」
dialogues.en: "N, no... not really..."
dialogues.text: "N, no... not really..."

dialogues.jp: 何故か困ったように口ごもる工藤。
dialogues.en:
Kudou's speech patterns denoted a large amount of
discomfort.
dialogues.text:
Kudou's speech patterns denoted a large amount of
discomfort.

dialogues.jp: なんだかなぁ……。
dialogues.en: I wonder...
dialogues.text: I wonder...

dialogues.jp:
俺は、そんな工藤をしばらく眺めていたが、こ
らえきれず大きな｛あくび／欠伸｝ひとつ。
dialogues.en:
I looked Kudou over once, then leaned back, stretched, and
released a big yawn.
dialogues.text:
I looked Kudou over once, then leaned back, stretched, and
released a big yawn.

dialogues.jp: 「ふわぁ…………ま、どうでもいっか」
dialogues.en: "Fuwaa.... well, whatever."
dialogues.text: "Fuwaa.... well, whatever."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.en: "Eh?"
dialogues.text: "Eh?"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「別に家がどんなだろーが、工藤は工藤だしな」
dialogues.en: "Whatever your heritage, you're still you."
dialogues.text: "Whatever your heritage, you're still you."

dialogues.jp:
それで何か変わるのかと言われれば、別に何も
変わらないだろうし。
dialogues.en:
Although my words implied that something had changed, in
truth, nothing about our relationship changed at all.
dialogues.text:
Although my words implied that something had changed, in
truth, nothing about our relationship changed at all.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「………………な、何だよ〜。｛き／訊｝いたのは朝倉
　じゃないか」
dialogues.en:
".........W, what's that about~. It's not like you to say
something like that."
dialogues.text:
".........W, what's that about~. It's not like you to say
something like that."

dialogues.jp:
しょうがない奴だな、と言いながらも、工藤の
声音はどこかほっとしたような色を帯びていた。
dialogues.en: "What a weird guy", he was trying to imply with his tone.
dialogues.text: "What a weird guy", he was trying to imply with his tone.

dialogues.jp: 「じゃ、お遣いの品、落とすなよ」
dialogues.en: "Later, don't forget your errand."
dialogues.text: "Later, don't forget your errand."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「お前といっしょにすんなっての」
dialogues.en: "Not like there's anything to think about with you."
dialogues.text: "Not like there's anything to think about with you."

dialogues.jp:
笑いながら去っていく工藤に、俺はかるく手を
挙げ、ひらひらと振って見せたのだった。
dialogues.en:
He left with a parting shot and a smile, as I waved to his
shrinking back.
dialogues.text:
He left with a parting shot and a smile, as I waved to his
shrinking back.

dialogues.jp: ◆工藤はお坊ちゃま？◆
dialogues.en: ◆Kudou's a Rich Kid?◆
dialogues.text: ◆Kudou's a Rich Kid?◆

dialogues.jp: 家に帰る途中、お遣い途中の工藤に会った。
dialogues.en:
On the way home, I ran into Kudou in the middle of an
errand.
dialogues.text:
On the way home, I ran into Kudou in the middle of an
errand.

dialogues.jp:
しかし、自分のばあちゃんのことを、お祖母さ
まなんて呼ぶとは…こいつって、案外育ちがい
いのかもしれないな。
dialogues.en:
He was calling his grandma rather formally... maybe he's had
a better upbringing that I thought.
dialogues.text:
He was calling his grandma rather formally... maybe he's had
a better upbringing that I thought.

dialogues.jp: ま、どうでもいいけど。
dialogues.en: Whatever though, anything's fine with me.
dialogues.text: Whatever though, anything's fine with me.
